recognize_zh: 小淋巴球背景中有一顆巨大的雙核細胞，兩個核呈對稱「鷹眼」樣，CD30 在細胞膜與細胞質呈強陽性；小淋巴球完全陰性，這就是典型的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞 CD30 染色型態。
features: Single very large binucleate cell with two mirror-image round nuclei (owl-eye appearance)
Nuclei with central nucleoli visible through the counterstain
Strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD30 staining
Background of small CD30-negative lymphocytes and histiocytes
Faint scattered CD30 staining in rare background cells only
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 shows a very large binucleate cell with two mirror-image nuclei containing central nucleoli, displaying strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD30 positivity. The surrounding small lymphocytes and histiocytes are negative. In classical Hodgkin lymphoma, the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are typically CD30+ and CD15+, with weak PAX5 and loss of CD45 and CD20; EBV (EBER) positivity was reported in this case. Findings are consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell of classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, often ALK+ and EMA+, and lacks PAX5 and CD15.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (LP cells)
ddx.vs: LP 'popcorn' cells are CD30-negative, CD20+, and CD45+, unlike the CD30+ Reed-Sternberg cell.
Reactive CD30+ immunoblasts retain CD45 and strong CD20/PAX5 and lie in a polymorphous activated background rather than showing classic HRS phenotype.
THRLBCL large cells are CD20+/CD45+ and usually CD30-negative, scattered in a T-cell and histiocyte background.
